register_decomposition: register a decomposition decorator for an aten op that scripts and optimizes the function for JIT
check_decomposition_has_type_annotations: check that a decomposition function has proper type annotations on all parameters and return type
signatures_match: verify that a decomposition function signature matches the original torch op signature
var_decomposition: compute variance by decomposing aten.var.correction into mean subtraction, squaring, and sum operations
var: compute unbiased or biased variance by decomposing aten.var.default into var_decomposition with correction parameter
